Brunch with Purpose – The Batter & Berries Story
================================================

We are open for DINE-IN, Carry-Out, and Delivery!

Our Story
---------

Established in 2012 by Dr. Tanya & Craig Richardson, who had the desire to add an eclectic world-class restaurant to the vibrant Chicago brunch scene.  The idea was simple: offer the freshest food possible with flavors that people would come from all over the world to experience, and want to come back for more.  Always a supporter of community and local businesses, we have taken the idea to the next level with cultivated partnerships.  We’ve collaborated with several local artisans, craftspeople, and purveyors to provide a uniquely Chicago experience.  

We’re here for you!
-------------------

We’re driven by our passion for good food and people and are here for your service.  We simply want to provide you with delicious food, a fun and uplifting atmosphere, and serve you with joy.  We take great pride in our menu consisting of freshly prepared items (yes, we crack our own eggs & shred the potatoes daily) and collaborations with other local artisans, purveyors & craftspeople for a truly unique experience.

  

**We’re Open for Dine-In, Delivery & Take-Out Tuesday, Wednesday, & Thursday 9:00am-2:00pm AND Friday-Monday 8:00am- 3:00pm**

Meet The Family
---------------

![Dr. Tanya Richardson](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D600%2Cheight%3D600%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/9c017ae3-7b22-449a-8cc5-df765c34259f.jpg)

### Dr. Tanya Richardson

#### (The Doc)

Founder & Owner

Born and raised In Chicago, Dr. Richardson believes in giving people the best experience possible. She is the creative force behind the bright floral decor, hand-crafted tables, and artwork selections.

![Craig Richardson ](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D600%2Cheight%3D600%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/783ef562-e1fc-45d3-8496-4d3f1e5b70b2.jpg)

Craig Richardson
----------------

### (The Que)

Managing Owner

Known as “The Que” to outsiders, to us, he is “Mr. Happy”.  Always wearing something purple, you can sometimes catch him dining, conversing with guests, or ensuring things run smoothly. His motto is that we are in the “happy people business,” and he aims to provide his guests with world-class customer service!

![Ken L. Polk](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D600%2Cheight%3D600%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/77f7b68b-250b-4a76-bcc8-facb9c7f2810.jpg)

Ken L. Polk
-----------

### (The Chef)

A Chicago native son and consummate foodie with Southern roots, Northern flair, and global experiences. He brings over 25 years of culinary expertise to the B&B kitchen. His passion is food and serving people the best, most flavorful food possible.

Taste the World-Famous French Toast at Batter & Berries
=======================================================

World famous… Really?

Since day one, our French Toast Flight has had foodies talking—from Chicago to Tokyo, Paris to Portland. Batter & Berries' legendary French Toast is more than a menu item. It's a movement. And yes—it really is world famous.

![map](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D600%2Cheight%3D600%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/75f3879b-f685-4cd6-9ef3-771ffdac694f.jpg)

The Original French Toast Flight
--------------------------------

Each week our Special French Toast changes; while some toasts are repeats, new flavors are given a new number! The other Chef Specials are created to highlight seasonal, cultural, or other preparations and are subject to availability!

![Champagne](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D1200%2Cheight%3D1200%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/4b3f6454-1f17-4309-b46a-801628627626.jpeg)

Champagne French Toast!
-----------------------

Champagne and White chocolate battered French Toast topped with Champagne Cremé , Caramel sauce and Gold Sequins!!  
  
Happy 2024!

![waffle](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D1200%2Cheight%3D1200%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/bf317bbb-42f3-42a8-87bb-dd1447c227f6.webp)

Breakfast
---------

Breakfast is our claim to fame! With our World Famous French Toast Flight, which combines our four signature flavors of batter-dipped Brioche, you will surely find your favorite! We also make things from scratch around these parts, with our hand-shredded B&B Cheese Crusted Hash Browns, house-made B&B Maple Chicken & Apple, or B&B Spicy Pork sausage; you can taste the Love!  
  

![lunch](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D1200%2Cheight%3D1200%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/90f64ff9-1e95-48e9-a414-0d4ee5ca87bc.webp)

-----

![brunch](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D1200%2Cheight%3D1200%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/c502267b-a5a0-4ec9-852f-2e685d705f3b.webp)

------

Brunch at Batter & Berries is like none other! With items like our French Toast Flight, Cluck & Gaufre (goof), La Colombe Brisket, or The PortaBella Hash, there is something for everyone to love!

Batter & Berries was founded by Dr. Tanya & Craig Richardson in 2012 as an eclectic breakfast, lunch, and brunch restaurant. The purpose was simple: provide a world-class dining experience like no other. We have done just that by providing guests with unique food options and an upbeat & invigorating atmosphere.

What makes us special is our approach to serving you, our guests; we serve you the way we want to be served, with love. Most of our menu items are made in-house each day. Every egg is cracked by hand, our sausages are hand-made from locally sourced poultry and maple Leaf Farms Pork, and our potatoes are shredded fresh daily.  We use 100% Pure Maple Syrup, nothing artificial. Our French Toast batters and sauces are made with fresh fruit, which leaves an unmistakable impression on the palate.

Batter & Berries is a melting pot and community hub.  We also are very proud to partner with other local artisans, craftspeople, and businesses to further provide selections you simply won’t get anywhere else. Collaborations include; La Colombe Coffee Roasters, Burnt City Brewing, Delilah’s Bar, Love Cork Screw, Brown Sugar Bakery, Noir D’ Ebene Patisserie, CCap, After School Matters, Chicago Public Schools Culinary Arts, to name a few.  Simply put, we love what we do here and hope you will too!

  

**We’re here for you!**
